title: Vandenberg and Malmstrom as recurring UFO hotspots
place_text: Vandenberg AFB, California; Malmstrom AFB, Montana

tellings.quote: It's one of these places like Malmstrom uh you know base in Montana where throughout the years you have recurring patterns of UFO sightings.

plain: Two American military bases are said to be places where UFO sightings keep coming back over the years. One is Vandenberg Air Force Base in California, the other is Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about a guard at a nuclear missile site who says he was taken by aliens, and he uses it to suggest that these bases draw unexplained visitors again and again.
